correctness.rationale: Reconstructed every quantitative step: the full-dimensional KKT support cells yield J_A; edge coarea reduces exactly to cut indicators; for k active vertices and a,b on opposite sides the internal-edge contribution is <=ab(n-k)/k and cross-cut contribution <=|∂S|. The maximum of floor(k²/4)(n-k)/k has the claimed n(mod 4) closed form via exact deficit identity. Matching q bridges between active endpoints of two sufficiently large cliques and arbitrary inactive vertices attain both inequalities. The two cliques have edge-connectivity exactly q and nearby inputs remain on same support cell, giving exact finite-pair attainment. Exact rational checker from package path passed 685,194 exhaustive support/cut comparisons over all connected labelled graphs with 2 to 5 vertices, plus 45,000 randomized inequalities and 45 exact matching-bridge nonlinear witness tests. Finite diagnostics support but do not replace the proof. For n=2,3 the q=1 construction uses an empty inactive group as required.

The exact all-graph cut/active-support formula, sharp hierarchy by edge connectivity, attained bridge-clique construction and quadratic n²/16 extreme instability are structurally informative, unlike a small finite table. The contrast with single-signal contraction is substantive. No downstream general theorem is claimed.
